_comment: Written by hand, before the first probe. Half of all bad harvests are a matching problem, not a visibility problem — this file is what prevents that.
_aliases_note: Every spelling a model might use. Include the legal name, the social handle, and any old name people still use. Do NOT include generic words — an alias of 'Example' plus an alias of 'App' will match half the internet.
_domains_note: Used for the self-citation rate. Include docs and blog subdomains — being cited via your own docs still counts as owning the source.
_products_note: Product names distinct from the brand name. A model may recommend the product without naming the company.
_competitors_note: The 3-6 that actually come up in deals. Not the aspirational list. If sales doesn't recognise a name here, take it out.
_known_confusions_note: Same-name entities the model may fuse you with. Feeds hallucination-watch's 'conflated' class.
